title: Open a Remote Session from the CLI with --on
body:
Make `foreman open --on <name> -- <command>` open a Session on a Remote through the launch builder. The Session remembers which Remote it is on. Add `foreman remotes` and mark Remote Sessions in status.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (sections: Launch, Control plane)
Blocked by: Remote settings model and the SSH launch builder
Done when:
- open --on with a mapped directory, or with --cwd, spawns the ssh argv from the builder; no mapping and no --cwd is an error naming both fixes
- an unknown Remote name is an error; a request without `on` is byte-identical on the wire to today (compat test beside the existing ones)
- the tab icon for `open --on X -- codex` is the Codex icon
- status text and --json carry the Remote name for Remote Sessions only
- `foreman remotes` lists name and target
- this card passes no Tunnel flags yet; the builder's Tunnel input is optional
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent remote; cargo test --target-dir target/agent control
